x-contract.authorization: Current management session with live agent:publish in an active Team workspace; no PAT or model tokens.
x-contract.snapshot: A new publish freezes the exact normalized saved draft and inline schemas after rechecking current model and workspace policy. No bindings, model execution, channel credentials or budget reservation.
x-contract.atomicity: Snapshot, next version number, current release pointer, metadata revision, receipt and redacted durable audit commit together. The draft remains unchanged.
x-contract.replay: Scope includes actor, Team, workspace and operation; the actual Agent ID is additionally included in request intent. Reusing a scoped key for another Agent conflicts. Same key/normalized intent returns the original version after live authorization. Replay never reactivates an old version or republishes a later draft; retained expired keys cannot create again.
x-contract.conflict: A stale draft_revision returns AG_DRAFT_REVISION_CONFLICT with frozen core error shape; reread the authorized draft before retrying with a new intent.

draft_revision.description: Canonical positive JSON integer spelling only; decimal, exponent and string spellings are rejected by the server.

release_note.description: Optional; at most 4096 valid UTF-8 bytes before trimming. Omission and an empty note have the same intent.

id.description: Canonical positive signed-int64 decimal string, maximum 9223372036854775807.

agent_id.description: Canonical positive signed-int64 decimal string, maximum 9223372036854775807.

config_hash.description: Canonical frozen configuration SHA-256; not an authorization credential.

published_at.description: Publication time in UTC Unix milliseconds.
